status: exact reflection-positive 1+1-dimensional compact SU(2) transfer system and scaling audit; not a four-dimensional mass-gap proof

system.hilbertSpace: L2(SU(2), Haar)^Ad with orthonormal character basis chi_j, j=0,1/2,1,...
system.reflectionPositivity: for f=sum_j f_j chi_j, <f,T_t f>=sum_j exp[-t C2(j)] |f_j|^2 >= 0

timeContinuumScaling.lesson: transfer eigenvalues coalesce at one as the time cutoff is removed; the Hamiltonian gap is the logarithmic slope, not a cutoff-uniform separation of transfer eigenvalues

spatialCircleScaling.rule: kappa=g_2^2 L/2, so Delta=3 g_2^2 L/8
spatialCircleScaling.lesson: the states are global electric-flux sectors on a circle; the model has no local propagating gluon degrees of freedom and its growing flux energy is not a four-dimensional glueball bound

wilsonCharacterCorrection.warning: replacing beta/4 by the exact one-plaquette character coefficient resums local powers but does not include higher connected surfaces, handles or screening graphs

fourDimensionalObstruction.missingMagneticDynamics: the one-cylinder transfer operator is a group Laplacian with no spatial-plaquette magnetic term coupling an infinite three-dimensional link system
fourDimensionalObstruction.wrongDimension: in 1+1 dimensions g_2^2 has mass dimension two and the theory reduces to global flux sectors; in 3+1 dimensions the coupling is dimensionless and local transverse gauge dynamics remains
fourDimensionalObstruction.continuumRequirement: for a finite physical gap Delta, the lattice mass a*Delta must tend to zero while the correlation length in lattice units diverges
fourDimensionalObstruction.fixedTFailure: holding t>0 fixed while a_tau tends to zero sends the inferred physical gap (3t/4)/a_tau to infinity
fourDimensionalObstruction.strongCouplingFailure: the convergent strong-coupling neighborhood is not the asymptotically-free weak-bare-coupling continuum trajectory
fourDimensionalObstruction.volumeFailure: finite-volume positivity and a discrete spectrum do not establish thermodynamic-limit Schwinger functions, clustering, or a gap uniform in volume and cutoff
fourDimensionalObstruction.localityFailure: the exactly diagonalized class-function Hilbert space does not construct the local gauge-invariant observable algebra on R^4
fourDimensionalObstruction.nontrivialityFailure: no regulator-independent interacting four-dimensional continuum measure or Osterwalder-Schrader reconstruction is produced

oneLoopBoundaryWitness.wilsonBetaRule: beta=4/g0^2=8 b0 log[1/(a Lambda)] at one loop
oneLoopBoundaryWitness.meaning: the leading beta/4 strong-coupling formula becomes nonsensical as a positive string-tension estimate before the a Lambda -> 0 continuum limit; this marks breakdown of the expansion, not deconfinement

spin23Boundary.compactLesson: positive character coefficients and a positive invariant Haar measure make the compact transfer construction work
spin23Boundary.noncompactWarning: Spin(2,3) is noncompact, so neither Haar normalization nor this positive discrete character sum transfers by common complexification
spin23Boundary.permittedUse: the calculation is a benchmark for a compact internal SU(2) or Spin(5) sector and a checklist for any proposed positivity-preserving bridge
spin23Boundary.notPermitted: it cannot gap the full Spin(2,3) gravitational connection, which must retain a massless spin-2 sector

decision: The minimal SU(2) heat-kernel transfer system exactly proves reflection positivity and a finite Hamiltonian gap in its own 1+1-dimensional global-flux Hilbert space. Its exact solvability also exposes every missing quantifier needed for the four-dimensional theorem; no finite refinement of this model can supply the absent local magnetic dynamics, thermodynamic construction, or asymptotically-free continuum bound.
